title: Diagnose and unblock native promotion drain recovery for PERSONA-CRON-REGISTRATION-20261007
head_binding_policy: The final PR head SHA is bound by REVIEW_HEAD_SHA at independent reviewer approval time via scripts/git/task_review_merge_gate.py. This evidence manifest does not claim a commit can contain its own SHA.

diagnosed_admission_block.root_cause: Commit f96d405de (OPS-PIASTRA-STOP-20261007) set agents.piastra.max_parallel to 0, which caused evaluate_task_delivery_admission to report LANE_CAPACITY_REACHED (0 >= 0). For planned promotion drain recovery, worker_recovery_assignment_pair preserves the original owner PiAstra and reviewer Claude without falling back. With max_parallel 0, _worker_recovery_candidate_has_capacity returned False, causing the recovery receipt to remain pending indefinitely.
diagnosed_admission_block.resolution: Restored agents.piastra.max_parallel to 1 in .orchestrator/config.json, matching lupinchen account concurrency cap (1) without widening account capacity. Added regression test verifying blocked recovery at zero capacity and unblocked recovery with lupinchen capacity preservation.

preserved_invariants.receipt_lease: Canonical receipt generation lease promotion-drain-f2d24df1d9a4dd41fada7162e4b68623fa4d838debd2f0cc4f96cd8688b83433 preserved (fence_generation 2, task_generation 1)
preserved_invariants.assignment_pair: Original owner PiAstra and reviewer Claude preserved
preserved_invariants.authority: No hand-edited runtime or task JSON; no fake process receipts; supervisor remains sole dispatcher
preserved_invariants.account_capacity: lupinchen account limit remains 1; no account capacity widened
